paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.07% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.06%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-1.68%). Brent crude changed +5.27% to 105.88. Gold changed -0.13% to 4,181.6001. Bitcoin changed +2.08% to 83,376.9688. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.227%, a relative move of -0.80%. Among the firms tracked, ConocoPhillips (+8.12%) and BP (+7.34%) moved the most.
